annotations.title: Send a City build for approval

description: Send a MagicaVoxel .vox to GrowBlocks City for approval as a prop, landmark or building. The server checks it (size for its kind, triangles, voxart score; run growblocks_voxel check first) and GrowBlocks approves it before it goes into the City. A building may name a plot and a door to one of your own live games (game) with a ticket in SEED (half goes to you); door is the door voxel "x,y,z". Only when the human asks.

dir.description: The game folder (default: the folder the assistant runs in).
